products.name: Commercial Lending
products.description: Provides a range of commercial and industrial loans, including specialty lending such as structured finance, asset-based lending, SBA loans, and loans for working capital, equipment, and business expansion. These are delivered through in-person relationship banking and require significant financial capital and underwriting expertise.

products.name: Commercial Real Estate Lending
products.description: Offers loans secured by commercial real estate, including owner-occupied and non-owner occupied properties, construction, land, and multifamily loans. These require regulated infrastructure, physical collateral, and in-person underwriting and servicing.

products.name: Residential Mortgage Lending
products.description: Provides full-service residential mortgage products, including conforming loans, home equity loans, and multi-family loans, with origination, servicing, and secondary market sales. Delivered through a combination of branch-based and remote channels, with significant regulatory and underwriting requirements.

products.name: Consumer Lending
products.description: Offers consumer loans such as installment loans for personal, family, and household purposes, including auto, boat, and recreational vehicle loans. These are typically smaller, shorter-term loans delivered through branch and digital channels.

products.name: Public Finance Lending
products.description: Provides loans to charter schools and municipal customers, supporting public sector financing needs. These loans require specialized underwriting and compliance with public finance regulations.

products.name: Deposit Products
products.description: Offers a comprehensive range of deposit products for consumers and businesses, including checking, savings, money market accounts, and certificates of deposit. Delivered through branch, online, and mobile channels, requiring regulated infrastructure and technology.

products.name: Treasury Management Services
products.description: Provides treasury management and cash management products and services to business customers, including remote deposit and commercial transaction accounts. Delivered via digital platforms and in-person support, requiring technology and regulatory compliance.

products.name: Wealth Management and Trust Services
products.description: Offers wealth management, investment management, trust, and retirement plan services, including private banking and estate planning. Delivered by specialized advisors and trust professionals, requiring regulatory oversight and personalized service.

products.name: Mortgage Loan Servicing
products.description: Services residential mortgage loans for investors, including payment collection, escrow management, and reporting. Delivered through specialized servicing operations and technology platforms, generating fee income.

products.name: Insurance Solutions
products.description: Provides life, long-term care, and disability insurance products, as well as estate planning and generational wealth transfer solutions, through a dedicated insurance subsidiary. Delivered by licensed professionals and subject to insurance regulation.

products.name: Crude Oil Production and Sales
products.description: Exploration, horizontal drilling, and production of crude oil from conventional oil-saturated and liquids-rich formations in the Permian Basin, primarily in Yoakum County, Texas and Eddy County, New Mexico. Oil is collected at well sites and sold to purchasers at market prices, transported by truck or pipeline.

products.name: Natural Gas Production and Sales
products.description: Exploration, drilling, and production of natural gas associated with oil wells in the Permian Basin. Natural gas is gathered at the wellhead and sold to purchasers via pipeline interconnections under long-term agreements.

products.name: Natural Gas Liquids (NGLs) Production and Sales
products.description: Production of natural gas liquids (NGLs) as a byproduct of oil and gas extraction, separated and sold to purchasers. NGLs are transported via pipeline or truck from well sites or centralized facilities.

products.name: Commercial Asset and Vehicle Auction and Marketplace Services
products.description: Provides global onsite and online auction and marketplace platforms for buying and selling commercial assets and vehicles, including automotive, construction, transportation, government surplus, energy, mining, and agriculture equipment. Delivered through physical auction sites and digital platforms, requiring regulated infrastructure and technology investment.

products.name: Salvage Vehicle Auction and Remarketing Services
products.description: Operates digital and physical marketplaces for the sale and remarketing of salvage and total-loss vehicles, primarily serving insurance companies and buyers focused on recycling or parts. Delivered via proprietary auction platforms and requires compliance with vehicle regulations.

products.name: Asset Management and Market Intelligence Services
products.description: Provides end-to-end asset management, certified appraisals, and market data-driven intelligence for commercial equipment and vehicles. Delivered digitally via proprietary software platforms and analytics, serving lenders, rental companies, contractors, and dealers.

products.name: Equipment Lifecycle Management and Parts Procurement Platform
products.description: Offers a digital platform that supports equipment owners in managing the equipment lifecycle and integrates parts procurement with OEMs and dealers. Delivered as a software solution connecting equipment owners and parts manufacturers.

products.name: Transportation and Logistics Services
products.description: Provides end-to-end transportation, shipping, and customs clearance solutions for buyers and sellers of vehicles and equipment, including an online marketplace connecting shippers and carriers. Delivered through a combination of digital platforms and physical logistics operations.

products.name: Refurbishing and Inspection Services
products.description: Offers repair, paint, make-ready, and professional inspection services for vehicles and equipment to enhance value and buyer confidence. Delivered through physical service centers and on-site operations.

products.name: Financial Services for Equipment and Vehicle Transactions
products.description: Provides loan origination and brokerage services to match buyers with financial lending institutions for equipment and vehicle purchases. Delivered through a digital platform and partnerships with financial institutions.

products.name: Title and Settlement Services
products.description: Delivers a full suite of title documentation, settlement, and retrieval services to facilitate clear title transfer in vehicle and equipment transactions. Delivered through digital and manual processing, requiring regulatory compliance.

products.name: Catastrophe Response Services
products.description: Provides strategic catastrophe response services including real estate capacity, operational execution, transportation logistics, and vehicle merchandising and selling, primarily for large-scale disaster events. Delivered through coordinated logistics and operational teams.

products.name: Private-Label Contract Manufacturing of Nutritional Supplements
products.description: Manufacturing and formulation of vitamins, minerals, herbal and other nutritional supplements, as well as other health care products, for third-party brands. Products are produced in various forms (capsules, tablets, powders, chewable wafers) and delivered through certified, regulated facilities in the U.S. and Switzerland.

products.name: Beta-Alanine Raw Material and Ingredient Sales (CarnoSyn®, SR CarnoSyn®, TriBsyn™)
products.description: Direct sale and supply of patented beta-alanine raw material and proprietary ingredient formulations to third parties for use in sports nutrition, wellness, and healthy aging products. Delivered as powders, tablets, and capsules, with patent protection and trademarked branding.

products.name: Patent and Trademark Licensing (CarnoSyn®, SR CarnoSyn®, TriBsyn™)
products.description: Licensing of patents and trademarks related to beta-alanine ingredients to third parties, generating royalty and license revenue from use in their products. This is a non-manufacturing, intellectual property-based revenue stream.

products.description: Products and services for professional florists, including order settlement, advertising, web hosting, marketing, designer education, point of sale systems, and wholesale floral supplies, delivered via the BloomNet platform.

products.name: Bulk Distilled Spirits and Co-Products

products.name: Specialty Wheat Starches

products.name: Specialty Wheat Proteins and Texturized Plant Proteins

products.name: Commodity Wheat Starches

firms.firm: Bank of New York Mellon Corp

products.name: Securities Services
products.description: Comprehensive custody, asset servicing, and issuer services for institutional clients, involving regulated infrastructure and significant operational scale to safeguard and administer client assets globally.

products.name: Market and Wealth Services
products.description: A suite of services including payments, trade, clearance, collateral management, and related solutions, delivered through regulated banking infrastructure and technology platforms to institutional and wealth clients.

products.name: Investment and Wealth Management
products.description: Investment management and wealth advisory services for individuals and institutions, involving portfolio management, financial planning, and fiduciary services, delivered through both bank and non-bank subsidiaries.

products.name: Corporate Trust Services
products.description: Trustee, agency, and fiduciary services for corporate and municipal clients, supporting debt issuance and other structured finance transactions, delivered via regulated trust company subsidiaries.

products.name: Securities Brokerage and Clearing Services
products.description: Brokerage, trade execution, and clearing services for institutional and wealth clients, provided through Pershing and other subsidiaries using regulated trading and settlement infrastructure.

products.name: Foreign Exchange and Derivatives Services
products.description: Foreign exchange trading and derivatives solutions for institutional clients, involving regulated trading platforms and risk management expertise.

products.name: Optical Communications Solutions
products.description: Integrated optical fiber, cable, and connectivity solutions for carrier and enterprise networks, including fiber, cables, hardware, connectors, and assemblies, manufactured in multiple global facilities and delivered for telecommunications, data centers, and broadband infrastructure.

products.name: Display Glass Substrates
products.description: Precision glass substrates for flat panel displays (LCD and OLED), produced using proprietary fusion manufacturing processes in Asia, supplied to manufacturers of televisions, monitors, notebooks, tablets, and handheld devices.

products.name: Specialty Glass and Materials
products.description: Advanced glass, glass ceramics, crystals, and precision optics for mobile consumer electronics, semiconductor equipment, aerospace, defense, and other industrial markets, including Gorilla® Glass, semiconductor optics, and ultra-thin glass wafers, manufactured in the US, Asia, and Europe.

products.name: Automotive Emissions Control and Technical Glass Solutions
products.description: Ceramic substrates and filter products for vehicle emissions control, as well as technical glass and optic products for automotive interiors and exteriors, manufactured globally and supplied to emission control system manufacturers and automotive OEMs.

products.name: Life Sciences Laboratory Products
products.description: Consumables and equipment for laboratory research, drug discovery, diagnostics, and bioproduction, including plastic vessels, specialty surfaces, cell culture media, glassware, and general labware, manufactured in the US, China, Europe, and Latin America and sold globally under multiple brands.

products.name: High-Purity Polysilicon and Solar Materials
products.description: High-purity polysilicon for the solar power and electronics industries, as well as solar wafers and modules, produced by Hemlock Semiconductor Group and related businesses for use in solar cells, panels, arrays, and semiconductor manufacturing.

products.name: Pharmaceutical Glass Packaging
products.description: High-quality pharmaceutical glass tubing and vials designed to meet the rigorous needs of the pharmaceutical industry, produced and supplied to pharmaceutical manufacturers for drug packaging and delivery.

products.name: Commercial Lending
products.description: Provides a range of loans to business customers, including commercial loans, real estate term and construction loans, and mortgage warehouse lending. These are delivered through in-person relationship management and digital platforms, requiring significant financial capital and regulatory compliance.

products.name: Mortgage Finance
products.description: Offers mortgage finance services, including mortgage warehouse lending, primarily to businesses and mortgage originators. This involves providing short-term funding for mortgage loans prior to their sale or securitization, requiring financial capital and specialized risk management.

products.name: Deposit Products
products.description: Provides a variety of deposit accounts to both business and individual customers, including checking, savings, money market accounts, and certificates of deposit. These are delivered through physical branches and digital banking platforms, supported by regulated banking infrastructure.

products.name: Treasury Management Services
products.description: Offers treasury management solutions to business customers, including payment and receivables solutions (such as instant payments, wire, ACH, commercial card, merchant, and lockbox), liquidity management, and information reporting, delivered via a digital platform.

products.name: Investment Banking and Advisory Services
products.description: Provides investment banking services such as financial advisory, securities underwriting, sales and trading, research, and risk management (interest rate and foreign exchange), delivered by licensed professionals through Texas Capital Securities, requiring regulatory compliance and capital markets expertise.

products.name: Private Banking and Wealth Management
products.description: Delivers private banking services including investment management, lending solutions, depository products, financial planning, insurance, and trust and estate planning, tailored to high-net-worth individuals through dedicated advisors and supported by ongoing financial planning.

products.name: Online Banking Services (Bask Bank)
products.description: Provides online-only banking services through Bask Bank, offering deposit products such as checking, savings, and certificates of deposit, with unique rewards like American Airlines AAdvantage® miles in lieu of cash interest, delivered via digital channels.

products.name: Asset Management Services
products.description: Comprehensive asset management for commercial, residential, hospitality, and mixed-use real estate assets, delivered under long-term agreements to institutional and third-party owners. Services are provided by a team of real estate professionals and are primarily fee-based, requiring industry expertise and ongoing client engagement.

products.name: Property and Facility Management Services
products.description: Full-service property and facility management for commercial, residential, hospitality, and mixed-use properties, including security, porter/janitorial, concierge, firewatch, and related services. Delivered through wholly owned subsidiaries and requires in-person human labor and regulated infrastructure.

products.name: Development and Construction Management Services
products.description: Management of real estate development and construction projects for commercial, residential, and hospitality assets, including planning, entitlements, and oversight of construction activities. Services are provided to both affiliated and third-party owners and require specialized project management expertise.

products.name: Leasing and Marketing Services
products.description: Leasing and marketing of commercial, residential, and retail spaces within managed properties, utilizing digital and media-based platforms to attract tenants and maximize occupancy. Requires a combination of marketing expertise and real estate knowledge.

products.name: Parking Management Services
products.description: Management and operation of commercial parking garages and transit facilities, including both owned and third-party assets. Services include parking operations, security, and maintenance, delivered through the ParkX subsidiary and requiring regulated infrastructure and in-person labor.

products.name: Strategic Investment and Acquisition Advisory Services
products.description: Consultation and execution of strategic investments, acquisitions, asset recapitalization, and disposition for real estate owners and investors. Services include investment-related income, promote distributions, and advisory on public-private partnerships, requiring financial and industry expertise.

products.name: Cable Network Programming
products.description: Production and licensing of news, business news, and sports content distributed via cable networks (e.g., FOX News, FOX Business, FS1, FS2, Big Ten Network, FOX Deportes) to traditional and virtual MVPDs and digital platforms, primarily in the U.S. Content is created in-house and distributed through regulated cable infrastructure and digital apps.

products.name: Broadcast Television Programming
products.description: Production, acquisition, marketing, and distribution of entertainment and sports programming through the FOX broadcast network and affiliated local television stations. Content is produced in-house and by third parties, delivered over regulated broadcast infrastructure and digital platforms.

products.name: Advertising-Supported Video On Demand (AVOD) Streaming (Tubi)
products.description: Operation of Tubi, a free, ad-supported streaming service offering a large library of movies, TV episodes, original titles, and live channels. Content is acquired from partners and produced in-house, delivered digitally via apps and web platforms.

products.name: Digital Direct-to-Consumer Streaming Services
products.description: Subscription and free ad-supported streaming services (e.g., FOX Nation, FOX Weather, B1G+, FOX One) offering live and on-demand access to FOX news, sports, entertainment, and weather content. Delivered digitally via apps and web platforms, requiring digital infrastructure and content production.

products.name: Content Production and Licensing for Third Parties
products.description: Production of scripted, unscripted, animated, and live event programming by FOX Entertainment Studios and related entities for FOX platforms and external clients, including other networks and streaming services. Involves in-person creative labor and regulated production facilities.

products.name: Local News Programming
products.description: Production and distribution of local news content through FOX-owned and operated television stations and digital platforms, including live and recorded news coverage. Requires in-person reporting, regulated broadcast infrastructure, and digital distribution.

products.name: Consumer Finance Marketplace (Credible)
products.description: Operation of Credible, an online marketplace connecting consumers with personalized product and rate options for loans and insurance from multiple providers. Delivered digitally, requiring financial technology infrastructure and regulatory compliance.

products.name: Studio Lot Leasing and Production Services
products.description: Leasing of office space and provision of television and film production and post-production services at the FOX Studio Lot to third-party industry clients. Involves physical facilities, regulated infrastructure, and in-person labor.

products.name: Spacecraft and Satellite Manufacturing
products.description: Design, manufacture, integration, testing, and delivery of spacecraft, satellites, landers, and surface systems for government and commercial customers. This involves physical manufacturing, engineering, and systems integration for deployment in LEO, GEO, cislunar, and deep-space environments.

products.name: Lunar Cargo Delivery Services
products.description: Delivery of payloads, cargo, and infrastructure to the lunar surface using lunar landers, primarily for NASA, commercial, and international customers. This service requires mission planning, spacecraft operation, and compliance with spaceflight regulations.

products.name: Space Communications and Data Relay Services
products.description: Provision of persistent communications, navigation, command and control, and data relay services via satellite constellations and ground networks, supporting operations in lunar, cislunar, and deep-space environments. Delivered through network integration and satellite infrastructure.

products.name: Mission Operations and Infrastructure-as-a-Service
products.description: Ongoing mission operations, spacecraft management, navigation and timing services, and infrastructure-enabled offerings for deployed space assets. Delivered as recurring services to civil, defense, and commercial customers, leveraging connected infrastructure.

products.name: Hosted Payload Services
products.description: Integration and operation of third-party payloads on company-built spacecraft and satellites, offering customers access to space infrastructure for their instruments or experiments. Involves technical integration, launch, and operational support.

products.name: Earth Imaging Satellite Manufacturing
products.description: Design and manufacture of high-resolution Earth-imaging satellites for commercial customers, involving advanced spacecraft platforms and imaging payload integration. Delivered as physical satellites for Earth observation applications.

products.name: Space Domain Awareness and Tracking Services
products.description: Provision of space domain awareness, tracking, and constellation management services for national security and commercial customers. Delivered through networked satellite systems and ground-based operations.

products.name: Lunar Surface Infrastructure and Mobility Systems
products.description: Development and delivery of lunar surface infrastructure, including mobility systems, power systems, and autonomous operations platforms. Involves physical manufacturing and deployment for lunar exploration and operations.

products.name: Upscale Steakhouse Restaurants (STK)
products.description: Operates and franchises STK restaurants, offering premium steaks, seafood, and specialty cocktails in a high-energy, upscale dining environment with a modern twist, typically in large metropolitan locations. Delivery is through owned, managed, licensed, and franchised venues.

products.name: Japanese Teppanyaki and Sushi Restaurants (Benihana and Benihana Express)
products.description: Operates and franchises Benihana and Benihana Express restaurants, featuring interactive teppanyaki dining with chefs preparing food tableside, as well as sushi and cocktails, in an energetic, communal atmosphere. Benihana Express offers a smaller format with a limited menu and no teppanyaki grills.

products.name: Polished Casual Grill and Sushi Restaurants (Kona Grill and RA Sushi)
products.description: Operates Kona Grill and RA Sushi restaurants, offering American favorites, steaks, seafood, award-winning sushi, and specialty cocktails in a polished casual, bar-centric, and vibrant dining atmosphere. Delivery is through owned and operated venues.

products.name: Hospitality Food & Beverage Management Services (ONE Hospitality)
products.description: Provides tailored food and beverage management, development, and consulting services for hotels, casinos, and high-end venues, including operating restaurants, bars, rooftop lounges, banqueting, catering, private dining, and in-room dining on a contract basis. Delivered through management agreements and leases.

products.name: Other Specialty Restaurant Concepts (Salt Water Social, Heliot, Radio, Rivershore Bar & Grill)
products.description: Operates and manages a portfolio of unique, branded restaurant and bar concepts, each with distinct culinary offerings and atmospheres, often located within hotels or casinos. Delivered through owned or managed venues.

products.name: VirnetX One Security Platform
products.description: A security-as-a-service platform based on Zero Trust Network Access (ZTNA) principles, providing end-to-end encrypted communications and integrating with existing enterprise systems. Delivered via cloud, on-premise, or hybrid deployments, it protects applications, services, and infrastructure.

products.name: VirnetX Matrix Secure Access Solution
products.description: An enterprise security solution leveraging the VirnetX One platform to provide encrypted, identity-based access controls for internet-enabled applications, connected devices, and control systems. Deployable without major infrastructure changes, it offers centralized policy enforcement and visibility.

products.name: VirnetX War Room Secure Collaboration Platform
products.description: A secure collaboration and visualization platform built on VirnetX One, enabling controlled access to virtual meeting environments with user and device validation. Designed for sensitive, unclassified but secure communications in sectors like government, law enforcement, legal, financial, and healthcare.

products.name: Digital Engineering and Cybersecurity Consulting Services
products.description: Professional services supporting cybersecurity integration, system design, advanced modeling, and cyber threat assessment for federal, state, and local government agencies. Includes digital engineering, cyber MBSE, and cyber threat intelligence services, delivered through consulting and project engagements.

products.name: Restaurant Food and Beverage Sales
products.description: Portillo’s operates multichannel restaurants serving made-to-order Chicago-style hot dogs, Italian beef sandwiches, burgers, salads, fries, and desserts. Food is prepared in open kitchens and delivered via dine-in, drive-thru, carryout, delivery, and catering, requiring physical restaurant infrastructure and in-person labor.

products.name: Corrugated Packaging Products
products.description: Manufactured at corrugated products plants using containerboard produced in-house, these include shipping containers, multi-color boxes, retail displays, and honeycomb protective packaging. Production involves physical manufacturing at 91 facilities, with design and printing capabilities, and products are delivered primarily by truck to customers within a 150-mile radius.

products.name: Containerboard (Linerboard and Corrugating Medium)
products.description: Produced at ten containerboard mills using both virgin and recycled fiber, these are base papers (linerboard and corrugating medium) used in the manufacture of corrugated packaging. Sold both internally to PCA plants and externally to domestic and export customers, production requires regulated, capital-intensive mill infrastructure.

products.name: Uncoated Freesheet (UFS) Paper
products.description: Manufactured at a dedicated paper mill, this includes commodity and specialty uncoated freesheet papers such as cut-size office papers and printing/converting papers, with options for custom features like colors, coatings, and recycled content. Production is capital- and energy-intensive, using renewable and recycled fibers, and products are distributed via direct shipment and distribution centers.

products.name: Deposit Accounts
products.description: Includes checking, savings, and time deposit accounts offered to individual, business, governmental, and institutional customers. These are managed through physical branches and digital banking infrastructure, and are regulated and insured by the FDIC.

products.name: Lending Services
products.description: Provides residential, commercial and agricultural real estate loans, commercial and industrial loans, state and political subdivision loans, and consumer loans. Loans are originated and serviced through branch offices and mortgage centers, requiring significant financial capital and regulatory compliance.

products.name: Trust and Investment Services
products.description: Offers a full range of client investment, estate, mineral management, and retirement services through a dedicated Trust and Investment division. These services involve fiduciary management and financial advisory, delivered by specialized personnel.

products.name: Insurance Services
products.description: Provides insurance products and services to customers through its subsidiary, First Citizens Insurance Agency, Inc. These services are delivered by licensed agents and require regulatory compliance.

products.name: Consumer Banking Services
products.description: Includes accepting time and demand deposits and originating consumer loans, delivered through physical branches and digital channels, requiring regulated infrastructure and in-person or digital customer service.

products.name: Commercial and Small Business Banking Services
products.description: Provides deposit accounts and a range of commercial loans to small and medium-sized businesses, delivered via branch network and relationship managers, requiring regulated financial capital and underwriting.

products.name: Wealth Management and Trust Services
products.description: Offers trust services (executor, trustee, guardian), private investment account management, and wealth advisory for individuals and institutions, delivered by licensed professionals and digital platforms, requiring regulatory compliance and fiduciary oversight.

products.name: Brokerage Services
products.description: Provides securities brokerage services to retail and institutional clients, delivered through licensed representatives and digital platforms, requiring regulatory compliance and integration with banking services.

products.name: Insurance Services
products.description: Offers insurance products and services to customers, delivered through a dedicated insurance subsidiary, requiring licensed agents and compliance with insurance regulations.
